relations.subject: Taigen Dan Leighton
relations.evidence: Leighton began his Zen practice in 1975 at the New York Zen Center, training under Kando Nakajima rōshi.

relations.subject: Taigen Dan Leighton
relations.evidence: In 1986, Leighton was ordained as a priest by Reb Anderson in the latter's first ordination ceremony. [...] In 2000, Leighton received shihō, or Dharma transmission, from Reb Anderson.

relations.subject: Taigen Dan Leighton
relations.evidence: Leighton lived in Japan from 1990–1992, translating Dōgen texts with Shōhaku Okumura and training under various masters.
